King Fahd Mosque (), also known as King Fahd Bin Abdul Aziz Alsaud Mosque ), in Alipašino polje, Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina is the largest mosque in Sarajevo as well as the Balkans. It was established and funded by Saudi Arabia.
